Derive the CTAS-shaped subjects, parameters and data from a long frame

BuildCTASInput.Rd

Re-splits the single long frame consumed by Analyze_CTAS() into the three data frames ctas::process_a_study() requires. country and region are populated with "no" when absent, matching the ctas defaults used in ctas::ctas_data.

Usage

BuildCTASInput(
  dfInput,
  strStudyCol,
  dfCustomTimeseries,
  dfCustomReferenceGroups
)
